en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a calm lakeshore or riverbank with a person standing in the left foreground looking across the water. On the opposite bank there is a small settlement and a prominent church with a steeple on a low hill, surrounded by trees and fields. Handwritten text appears along the lower border, and a printed caption at the bottom left reads "Vargø Fredenmarken" (or similar).
